test_name: Haptics stay on forever after losing an arm - b29b7e66-99b3-440c-9e7f-2b4732418639
summary: Passed: in the editor, an arm lost mid-slowed-punch no longer keeps buzzing the controller, and an arm that's still attached buzzes as before. The buzz loop only stopped when the arm left its slowed-punch state, and a lost arm never leaves it. The earlier fix covered multiplayer only, so I added the same check to the singleplayer mech. It compiles. One recompile took 53 seconds: 20 of those go to compiling the single huge main script assembly (2800+ files) while the rest of the build sits idle, plus 11 seconds reloading scripts afterwards.
